purpose: Collect genuinely prospective, outcome-sealed observations for a selective profitable-move detector that can abstain, without requiring a loop forecast.

opened_development_evidence.result: All five frozen bar-pattern detectors failed their accuracy, paired-control, net-payoff, stability, robustness, and cost gates.

problem_decomposition.question: Has price entered a state in which a usable move may begin?
Has the move begun in the forecast direction without invalidating the setup?
Is the conservative cost-adjusted expectancy positive now?
Given only the completed path, is remaining expectancy still positive?

activation_requirements: Set an immutable activation timestamp before the first prospective observation.
Freeze detector source, feature schema, label clock, risk construction, costs, uncertainty method, evaluation code, and source hashes before opening outcomes.
Keep append-only alert, confirmation, admission, completed-bar, and sealed-outcome ledgers separate.
Do not use 2023, 2024, 2025, or already-opened partial-2026 outcomes for activation-time feature, model, threshold, horizon, risk, or confirmation selection.
Any optional finer-bar source must be timestamp-audited and frozen before use; five-minute dual-touch rows remain ambiguous unless a valid finer path exists.
Activation or implementation through the trading application requires separate explicit authorization and remains outside this contract.

observation_population.selection: log the full eligible population before any detector or abstention filter

forbidden_features: realised target, stop, MFE, MAE, time-to-excursion, return, regime duration, loop, child, or morph outcome
same-bar intrabar ordering inferred from five-minute OHLC
order-book or quote-flow claims from provider historical volume

primary_outcome.name: target_before_structural_invalidation
primary_outcome.entry_clock: next provider open after a completed-bar admission
primary_outcome.target: frozen reward distance derived causally at admission
primary_outcome.stop: frozen structural invalidation derived causally at admission
primary_outcome.net: gross payoff minus 5 bps per side
primary_outcome.gaps: realised conservatively at the first available open

detector_output.positive_rule: emit positive only when the lower uncertainty bound of cost-adjusted expectancy is above zero

accuracy_definition.primary: selective target-before-invalidation precision over every emitted positive admission
accuracy_definition.coverage: positive admissions divided by the full eligible population
accuracy_definition.risk_specific_break_even: required; a fixed hit-rate threshold cannot replace net expectancy
accuracy_definition.calibration: report predicted-versus-realised probability by predeclared bins with confidence intervals

path_counterfactuals_logged_without_exec: next open after each frozen confirmation state
next open after positive, negative, or unknown detector state change
frozen structural target and invalidation path

requirements: minimum support and predeclared minimum coverage
precision and calibration conditional on coverage
multiplicity control across all detector, direction, horizon, and confirmation endpoints
independent leakage, timestamp, source-hash, outcome-seal, and exact-rerun audit

post_inspection_hypothesis.name: alert_then_confirm_then_test_continuation
post_inspection_hypothesis.motivation: V1 showed that expansion alerts did not separate target-first from stop-first paths; confirmation must be evaluated as a new causal admission clock rather than as hindsight filtering.
post_inspection_hypothesis.guard: No reclaim level, bar count, stop width, target width, or continuation horizon may be chosen from the opened V1 outcomes.

provenance_and_missingness.all_features: store source timestamp, availability timestamp, transform version, missingness reason, and support
